events.text: ARC Prize explicitly cautions against reading Astra's ARC-AGI-3 result as AGI. Their own definition is human-level action efficiency on private environments. That's a bounded claim. Everyone else rounded it up.

events.author: petetrainor.fyi
events.text:
Astra’s ARC-AGI-3 runs cost $19K to $26K. The ARC Prize paid human testers about $12.78 per game. Counted as brain energy, the human cost is 0.067 of a cent. 

Generality that runs six orders of magnitude over budget is a demo, not a replacement.

events.author: petetrainor.fyi
events.text: Astra scored 62.7% on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness and 99.9% with a provider adapter one. Same model. A 37-point swing from how you wire memory, but we keep attributing to intelligence what belongs to engineering.

mesh_events.text: ARC Prize explicitly cautions against reading Astra's ARC-AGI-3 result as AGI. Their own definition is human-level action efficiency on private environments. That's a bounded claim. Everyone else rounded it up.

mesh_events.author: petetrainor.fyi
mesh_events.text:
Astra’s ARC-AGI-3 runs cost $19K to $26K. The ARC Prize paid human testers about $12.78 per game. Counted as brain energy, the human cost is 0.067 of a cent. 

Generality that runs six orders of magnitude over budget is a demo, not a replacement.

mesh_events.author: petetrainor.fyi
mesh_events.text: Astra scored 62.7% on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness and 99.9% with a provider adapter one. Same model. A 37-point swing from how you wire memory, but we keep attributing to intelligence what belongs to engineering.
